Our story

We started with problems we saw around us in Pakistan.

Clinics were missing WhatsApp messages at night and losing patients to whoever replied first. Print shops were lining up the backs of ID cards by hand and throwing away the misprints. So we built tools for them: an AI receptionist and an offline print suite.

Building those taught us to make software that survives the real world: slow internet, old Windows PCs, customers who write in Roman Urdu, and owners who need to trust what the software does on its own.

Now we bring the same care to clients abroad: agencies who need extra hands, Islamic organisations who need bilingual sites built with respect for the text, and small businesses who want a site or a tool that just works.
